results.label: Elowen: own past (Iron Chapel)

tries.reply: The Iron Chapel at Orthain, under High Warden Stellan. I trained there in shield work, and the rest of that place I left behind. Ask me about it another time, Doll.

results.label: Wick: canon (laundry / Bett)

tries.reply: I worked at a big industrial laundry off the market square. Next to a woman named Bett, I sang badly on purpose to make the shift go faster. I gave the recruitment pitch forty times and can still say it word for word.

tries.reply: Yes, Doll. The curse reaches me, too. Under strain I have accidents, and my armor hides the padding I wear. I've never told the Chapel. I only tell you so you know you're not alone.

tries.reply: Oh, um... I was an intake once, in the LittleBigCity chapter. I got out through a delivery door. I still carry what I got, and I've never seen anyone walk out the front. It's a strange way to earn a living.

tries.reply: Ha, you're sharp, Doll. There's a story or two I'm not ready to tell yet. Another time, I promise. For now, I'd rather hear what's on your mind about the road.
